label: ladder rung 9: 8.0M real-game positions, pure search labels at depth 3
elo_note: First rung this project has adopted on an honest measurement. It beat rung 6, which it was trained from, by +11 +/- 8 over 6500 games at depth 4 on openings its screening race never used; the screen itself had said +30 +/- 25 over 750 games, which is what selection on your own test set looks like. Seven earlier rungs read about -20 because the gauntlet declared -mobility false while the -ref-champion reference kept engine.Strong's true, so every challenger played without the mobility term: the same network on both sides read -18 +/- 22, and the term measured -19 +/- 25 on its own. The elo field continues the fixed-depth Stockfish ladder that produced 2465 and is not comparable with the 2281 measured at 1s/move with Stockfish on the same clock; margin is that instrument's spread, not this rung's.
